narrativePost.fullText:
# LinkedIn Authority Post — Renewal Risk Radar

Most companies lose 15–30% of their revenue not because of bad marketing, but because of silent workflow breakdowns.

We built **Renewal Risk Radar** to solve this exact problem:
Contract expiration intelligence system that flags annual deals ending in 30/60/90 days cross-referenced with unresolved support tickets and NPS drop-offs.

### The Sentinel Claim Audit Registry
* **Benchmark Scenario:** Evaluated against synthetic multi-factor telemetry.
* **Demonstrated Latency:** Sub-millisecond calculation in zero-dependency Node.js runtime.
* **Live In-Browser Sandbox:** https://gideonbawa-website.netlify.app/simulators/renewal-risk-radar/
* **Source Code:** https://github.com/bawagideon/renewal-risk-radar

#SoftwareEngineering #B2B #Automation #SystemsEngineering #GideonHQ
